# DOCX test fixture

`mixed.docx` is a handcrafted OOXML ZIP, not a file produced or verified by
Microsoft Word. It combines Greek/Latin text and XML references; default and
heading styles; explicit bold-off; a hyperlink with an ampersand; a bookmark and
comment range; original/final text revisions; a footnote; a numbered merged table
cell; an inline transparent 512 × 256 PNG; two sections; a header/page field; and
an Impress-managed contents snapshot with a page-reference field. All text and
image bytes are generated by this project; no fonts are included.

Run the tests with `cargo test -p docx --test roundtrip`.
